content: Nnanga s'anọng asi s'irukhabe s'Ibinọkpaabyi osisi
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi,
“Kọ gbaak anọng p'Israẹl bi, bẹ achen-m ẹnanga. Kọ wọ atzọkha ẹnanga ch'ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'osi ochibhi bi, ọnang-m ẹnanga.
Ma wọ ode nnanga s'atzọkha k'anọng mba: gol, ọmaana silva, ọmaana brons,
ọmaana ndik sa nde adem blu, ọmaana sa ngor-ihiho, ọmaana sa ngor-izizi, ọmaana ndik-nyokhasẹ nkkakka, ọmaana avu-phyubha,
ọmaana ndenkpa s'erukhimaan-dim sa bẹ aphyok asi-khora, ọmaana ndenkpa nkkakka s'avu, ttara mgbaakha s'akasiya,
ọmaana ana p'oliv p'attwikkaang, ọmaana ekpo pya bẹ am-atzima asi ana pa bẹ am-abyengi anọng k'eho, ttara insẹns,
ọmaana atza pa oniks, atza akkakka adọdọk pa bẹ agbana k'ẹphọd
, ọmaana k'ẹbarakpa ch'ittemmọma.
“Mẹ wọ, tte bẹ asi irukhabe anang-m, ofona mẹ, kaam ńnuk k'ottem kwabẹ.
Si irukhabe nna, ọmaana effaangin-ẹkpo pyẹ, atzor bi hyẹẹr k'odem kwa kaam ńgọhkh-ọ.
Ẹkkọhbhi ch'Echekhi
“Tte bẹ atzima mgbaakha s'akasiya asi ẹkkọhbhi ch'adum pẹ áde ndọkhi nttaan ọmaana akpamma ọhawani, ẹkpa chẹ ede ndọkhi mfa ọmaana akpaama attaan, ebe chẹ ede ndọkhi mfa ọmaana akpamma attaan.
Tzima gol ọkkakka abhọri chẹ k'ẹtzaanga ọmaana k'iyaan, abira atzima gol abaanga ammakpabem pẹ, adokha akhọri.
Tzima gol arabha ariring anna, akhe bẹ ka ndọkhi nna s'ẹkkọhbhi nda. Ariring afa k'okhubha wani, afa k'okhubha nwonggo.
Tzima mgbaakha s'akasiya asi nneremmachi, abhọri sẹ ttara gol.
Kọ khe nneremmachi nna k'ariring mba p'awobh k'ẹbhabhaanga ch'ẹkkọhbhi nda, ifha bẹ atzima atzini chẹ.
Nneremmachi nna ngaambi nwobha m'ariring p'ẹkkọhbhi nda, bẹ kàkhaambi arọbha sẹ.
Kọ khe aphaangi pa kaam ńnang-ọ m'Ẹkkọhbhi nda ch'Echekhi ẹtzaanga.
“Tzima gol ọkkakka asi ẹkkọhbhikpa ch'ephyokhi. Adum pẹ áde ndọkhi nttaan ọmaana akpamma ọhawani, ẹkpa chẹ éde ndọkhi mfa ọmaana akpamma attaan.
Kọ tzima gol aduk achẹrubim afa, abera k'ikpiho s'ẹkkọhbhi nda.
Si cherub wani ahok k'eho dani, abira asi ọdọdọk ahok k'eho ndonggo. Kọ si achẹrubim mba ọmaana ẹkkọhbhikpa nda agbakha ayok, ka nho mfa s'ẹkkọhbhi nda.
Tte achẹrubim mba akhaama mbabaang sa mmẹma k'ẹrọng mbubha ẹkkọhbhikpa ch'ẹkkọhbhi nda, tte achẹrubim mba akkeri ayok itzitzikha, bẹ akkeri itzitzikha kẹ ẹkkọhbhikpa nda.
Kọ tzọkha ẹkkọhbhikpa nda akhubha k'ebir-ebir kw'Ẹkkọhbhi ch'Echekhi, atzọkha aphaangi pa kaam ńnang-ọ akhe m'ẹtzaanga.
M'ebir-ebir kw'ẹkkọhbhi-kpa nda, ọmaana k'ottem kw'achẹrubim mba p'awobh k'ebir-ebir kw'Ẹkkọhbhi ch'Echekhi nda, wọ kwa kaam ńgebh-ọ, mbiri nnang-ọ asana paam biphyir p'ánang anọng p'Israẹl.
Okpokkoro kwa brẹd kw'Ibinọkpaabyi
“Tzima mgbaakha s'akasiya asi okpokkoro. Adum pẹ áde ndọkhi nttaan, ẹkpa chẹ ede ẹtzọkhi dani ọmaana akpamma azadani, ebe chẹ ede ndọkhi mfa ọmaana akpaama attaan.
Kọ tzima gol ọkkakka abhọri okpokkoro nwa, abira atzima gol abanga ammakpabem adokh-ẹ akhọri.
Kọ biri si ammakpabem p'ẹkpa ebenga mach'ẹbọhkpattem, atzima gol adokha chẹ akhọri.
Tzima gol asi ariring anna p'okpokkoro nwa, adabh bẹ ma nnyọnga nna s'okpokkoro nwa, mẹ da mmo sẹ nna nwobh.
Ariring mba awobha abaanga m'ammakpabem p'ẹkkọhbhi nda, p'abọkha nneremmachi sa bẹ am-atzima atzini okpokkoro nwa.
Tzima mgbaakha s'akasiya asi nneremmachi nna, abhọri sẹ ttara gol, ifha bẹ am-atzima atzini okpokkoro nwa.
Tzima gol ọkkakka asi agbang-gbang, ọmaana nnengakpa, ọmaana akọbh, ttara agbere pa bọng átzima asi nnanga mbyengisẹ.
Nana brẹd kw'awurada m'okpokkoro nwa k'itzitzikha saam, k'ogbe kpenamkpen.
Etwikhikkaang-chi
“Kọ duk gol ọkkakka atzima asi ettwikkaang-chi. Orin kwẹ, ọmaana abọhnga, ọmaana akọbh, ọmaana agbok, ttara adodo pẹ, pyẹ éde echi nda dani.
Abọhnga azadani átzọhnga k'ẹbhabhaanga ch'ettwikkaang-chi, attaan awobha k'okhubha wani, attaan awobha k'okhubha nwonggo.
Akọbh attaan p'ade mach'adodo p'almọn, ttara agbok ọmaana adodo áwobha k'ẹbọhnga dani, attaan k'ẹbọhnga ẹdọdọk, ábira ade odem nwa wani ttara abọhnga mba azadani biphyir, p'ettwikkaang-chi nda.
Etwikhikkaang-chi nda ẹkhaama akọbh anna p'ade mach'adodo p'almọn ttara agbok, ọmaana adodo.

Ogbok wani owobha k'irekh-irek kw'abọhnga-gbakha p'acheden p'atzọhnga m'etwikkaang-chi nda, ogbok kw'ottong afa obiro owobha k'irekh-irek kw'abọhnga-gbakha p'attong afa, ottong agbok attaan, owobha k'irekh-irek kw'abọhnga-gbakha p'attong attaan. Biphyir-phyir bẹ ade abọhnga azadani.
Agbok ọmaana abọhnga mba biphyir áde echi nda dani, ọmaana etwikkaang-chi nda, cha bẹ atzima gol ọkkakka aduk.
“Mẹ wọ, si atwikkaang azenamfa, anana bẹ k'etwikkaang-chi nda, ifha bẹ amaani k'ottem kw'itzitzikha sẹ.
Tzima gol ọkkakka asi afhẹngbẹ, ọmaana nnengakpa s'ekpon okkikkibha.
Tzima gol ọkkakka asi etwikkaang-chi ch'ẹdọhbh chẹ ede talẹn wani, ọmaana idik kpenamkpen sẹ biphyir.
Kọ re bi asi ọttọhk kpenamkpen atzor k'eden cha kaam ngọhkh-ọ k'egbegbeho.

footnotes.text: 25.7 ẹphọd ede inọhmakhuma s'ọfọhn-ẹja s'ikhaam abọhk-kwuma p'aren ka mbabaang, ọmaana odikpa, ttara atza ọkkakka pa bẹ atzim adokha mbọhk sẹ ka mbabaang.
